title: Dogs In The Land Of Lions
desc: We follow the unforgettable journey of a family of wild dogs in Zimbabwe.

title: Big Cats Small World
desc: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba are teaching their cubs survival skills whilst keeping them out of the jaws of big male cats.

title: Life Of A Predator
desc: Track three apex predators: a golden eagle, an Iberian lynx and a red fox.

title: Fear on the Savannah
desc: Authorities introduced lions in a rehabilitated national park where only herbivores lived, and fear overtook the park.

title: A Game Of Leopard Thrones
desc: Filmed over ten years, an in-depth look at the leopard characters of South Africa and their fascinating unfolding story once their Queen dies.

title: Big Cat Tales
desc: Chongo is unwilling to share buffalo with the rest of the pride and Fig continues to give vital lessons to the young cub and a cheetah and hyena battle.

title: Surviving Australia
desc: Aussies who've encountered deadly threats in their own backyard share their stories.

title: Deadliest Snakes of South Africa
desc: Kurt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's 12 most deadly snakes and to educate and inspire people to see the value of these often misunderstood creatures.

title: Brotherhood of Lions
desc: Five male lion cubs compete with each other while hunting their prey, but their family ties become increasingly complicated as they make their gradual rise to reign in the territory.

title: Amur, Asia's Amazon
desc: The Amur or Heilongjiang, as it is called in China, is one of the planet's ten mightiest rivers, yet it is hardly known to westerners.
